notes: Standalone Rust verification profile; shipped Kani release omits unused playback and no_core trees, and Rust toolchain is restricted to the exact frontend shared libraries. Cargo integration and native playback execution are not qualified.
Result is for exactly 16 admitted u8 values and the declared unwind bound. The insufficient-unwind case must fail; no global or unbounded program-correctness claim is made.
Negative property prints a concrete counterexample test; this profile does not execute native playback. Host Linux x86_64 libc/libm/libgcc/zlib ABI is required.
The declared host C preprocessor/compiler (cc and gcc) is required by the CBMC toolchain; the executed environment reports GCC 13.3.0.

Runtime is a SHA-locked compressed capsule. CPG0.21.14 SDK must be importable by python3. CLI/check verifies and expands the full runtime into a private writable build directory per invocation, then removes it; CPG_RUNTIME_BUILD can choose a location outside the immutable prefix. Functional logs and inputs are retained separately from the temporary runtime.

The expanded capsule is additionally checked by the original SDK ELF/runtime checker against actual current_target; its private libraries must resolve inside that expansion. Undeclared ambient LD_* variables are excluded from qualified execution.
usage.summary: Kani 0.68.0 + exact Rust frontend + CBMC 6.11.0 for bounded finite-domain algorithm proofs.
